_Last updated: {{< var updated >}}_

The short version: this website collects as little as possible. We only know
about you what you choose to tell us when you write to us, plus anonymous
visit statistics if you accept the analytics cookie.

## Who is responsible for your data

The data controller is **{{< var legal-name >}}**, {{< var city >}}. Contact for any privacy request:
[{{< var email >}}](mailto:{{< var email >}}).

## What we collect, and why

| Data | When | Why (legal basis, GDPR art. 6) | Kept for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name, email, organisation, your message | You use the contact form or email us | To answer you and, if you ask, prepare a proposal (steps prior to a contract, art. 6.1.b) | 24 months after our last exchange, unless a contract follows |
| Anonymous usage statistics (pages viewed, device type, approximate country) | Only if you click **Accept** on the cookie banner | To understand which content is useful (consent, art. 6.1.a) | 14 months |
| Technical logs (IP address, browser) | Every visit, kept by our hosting provider | Security and to deliver the site (legitimate interest, art. 6.1.f) | As set by the provider |

We do not sell personal data, use it for advertising, or make automated
decisions about you.

## Cookies {#cookies}

- **Necessary storage:** we save your cookie choice in your browser so we do
  not ask again. No consent needed.
- **Analytics (optional):** Google Analytics 4, loaded **only after you
  accept**, with IP anonymisation. You can change your mind at any time via
  [Cookie settings](#){.cookie-settings} in the footer.

We do not use advertising or profiling cookies.

## Who else processes data

- **GitHub Pages** (GitHub Inc., USA) hosts the website.
- **Google** (Google Fonts for typography; Google Analytics only with consent).
- **Our email provider** receives the messages you send us.
- **YouTube** only when you click a link to our videos.

Some of these providers are based in the USA. Transfers rely on the EU-US Data
Privacy Framework or the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

## Your rights

You can ask to access, correct, delete, restrict or port your data, object to
its processing, and withdraw consent at any time, by writing to
[{{< var email >}}](mailto:{{< var email >}}). We answer within one month.
You can also complain to the Italian data protection authority,
the [Garante per la protezione dei dati personali](https://www.garanteprivacy.it).

## Changes

If this policy changes, we update it here and change the date at the top.
